checks.explanation: No D-selection disclosure text appears in the disclosures array, so placement cannot be evaluated.
No basic services fee line item is listed, so there is no includesText for that fee to evaluate.
No text describes a second mandatory charge for services, facilities or overhead.
No D-embalming disclosure appears in the disclosures array.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial or closed-casket arrangements.
The alternative-container disclosure and the direct cremation range both appear on page 1, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation is offered but no text states that a casket is required for it.
The direct cremation description includes cremation, and no separate cash-advance crematory fee is listed to create ambiguity.
All goods and services mentioned have their own priced lines, and no package, description or policy mentions an additional offered item without a price.
The list contains only required separate items like receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial, not an optional combination package.
No text asserts that any purchase is required by law, a cemetery or a crematory.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the alternative-container disclosure, which uses the expected language.
